subject: Exploring AWS Marketplace billing for Solstice renewal
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@solstice.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring AWS Marketplace billing for Solstice renewal

Hi Nora —

Quick note ahead of your renewal later this year (I have Sep 30 on our side). Solstice has been a fantastic partner and we wanted to discuss a simple path to convert your invoicing from our direct contract to AWS Marketplace. The move typically helps customers by: 
- letting procurement buy through AWS with a familiar PO process,
- unlocking co-sell eligibility and potential joint funding from AWS, and
- reducing internal legal redlines because procurement uses the marketplace terms.

I attached a short pricing matrix that maps our current SKU-level billing to the Marketplace SKU (marketplace-pricing-matrix.xlsx), plus a draft mutual action plan you can share with procurement/legal (mutual-action-plan_Solstice.docx).

High-level ask: are you open to a 30-min call next week to walk procurement through the timeline and required signing steps? If it helps, we can coordinate the DocuSign flow and show how a single PO to AWS replaces your current monthly invoice.

HubSpot deal: HS-23456 (for internal reference).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

Attachments: marketplace-pricing-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual-action-plan_Solstice.docx (doc)

From: Nora Patel <nora@solstice.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Lee <tim.lee@solstice.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring AWS Marketplace billing for Solstice renewal

Ben —

Thanks for the note and the materials. A couple quick asks from procurement/CFO: 
1) Pricing parity: will the Marketplace SKU price match our current committed rate (or is there a delta once AWS fees are included)?
2) PO and tax workflow: our AP team needs to confirm how tax and billing statements will be provided when the purchase is via AWS.
3) Contracting: can you provide the exact DocuSign template or Marketplace agreement examples so our legal can pre-clear them?

Tim (cc) wants to be sure the outflow plan preserves the discount band we negotiated. We have a renewal window starting 30 Sep, ideally finalizing by mid-Sep.

Can we do Wed 6/24 at 9:00 PT for a 30-min sync? If that time doesn't work, Nora please suggest alternatives.

Best,
Nora Patel
Head of Procurement, Solstice
nora@solstice.io

Subject: Re: Exploring AWS Marketplace billing for Solstice renewal

Nora / Tim —

Great questions. Short answers up front: 
- Pricing: We can maintain the committed discount band on the Marketplace SKU for the length of your renewal commitment. There is a nominal AWS transacting fee baked into Marketplace pricing (we show it in the attached pricing matrix) but we will match net pricing for the renewal year when the customer converts at renewal.
- PO & tax: AWS issues the invoice to your organization; tax handling is routed through AWS's billing system. We will provide an exportable billing breakdown and a monthly usage statement suitable for AP.
- Contracting: attaching the DocuSign marketplace purchase flow template here and a sample marketplace terms summary. The DocuSign link in my notes: https://www.docusign.com/solstice-template/XYZ123

I've attached an updated mutual action plan with milestones and owner assignments. If Wed 6/24 9:00 PT works, I'll block it and invite the relevant AWS SA so we can discuss co-sell opportunities and the seller-of-record implications.

Next steps (proposal):
1) Quick discovery call (30 min) with procurement, AP, and AWS SA — confirm 6/24 9:00 PT.
2) Redwood/Marissa to share mutual action plan and final Marketplace SKU mapping.
3) Legal/Procurement to review DocuSign/Marketplace terms; target finalization by 9/15.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual-action-plan_Solstice.docx, marketplace-pricing-matrix.xlsx (updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Solstice AWS marketplace enablement / co-sell notes

Team —

Looping in Sergio (partner/co-sell lead) and Neha (sales ops) to coordinate the technical onboarding and billing mapping for Solstice. Quick checklist to prepare before the 6/24 call: 
- Sergio: confirm AWS SA availability and whether Solstice qualifies for the co-sell funding band (I flagged HS-23456).
- Neha: prepare a clean SKU mapping CSV and the expected invoice sample from AWS so AP can reconcile quickly.
- Ben: confirm what legal artifacts Solstice needs and whether we should pre-populate the DocuSign envelope.

I've attached our internal co-sell playbook (co-sell-playbook.pdf) with the typical timelines and escalation points — share only the mutual action plan externally for now.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: co-sell-playbook.pdf (internal)

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and for pulling AWS into the thread. 6/24 9:00 PT works for procurement and Tim. We reviewed the pricing sheet and the delta looks acceptable when you show the net committed rate is preserved — please make that explicit in the MPA milestone table (we need a line that says "net effective price equals current committed rate for term").

Action items we will take:
- Legal will review the DocuSign template and circle back by 7/1 with any minor redlines.
- AP will confirm tax treatment with AWS billing and share a sample PO format by 7/3.

From our side, this route is attractive for both procurement efficiency and meeting our internal policy of routing cloud purchases through marketplace channels where possible. Let's aim to have the Marketplace conversion executed alongside the renewal signature in September.

Nora Patel
